CHAPTERS: The Elder waits at the village shrine.
Goblins raid the carts. Drive them back.
Face the King of the Keep and claim the first page.
Something takes the fenfolk children at night.
Grandma Silt holds the second page.
The forest to the west has closed its paths.
Speak with the warden of the wood.
Cut your way into the hollow.
Gather frostbloom for the stonekin healers.
Khalvorn the wyrm guards the fourth page.
Learn the dunes from the nomads.
Enter the crypt beneath the spire.
Smugglers lure ships to the rocks.
The Scourge of the Salt has the sixth page.
Pyrrhax burns with the seventh page.
Isvara's heart is the eighth page.
The temple warden guards the ninth page.
The lich who tore the Codex.
Lady Serrin welcomes you... too warmly.
Serrin reveals her pact with the dusk.
Return the Codex. The sun rises.
